confidence_notes: Restaurant, dorm and 3-star anchors rest on several crowd-sourced or listing snapshots dated 2022-2025, so they are approximate. The cocktail anchor relies on one reviewer's remark (about 100,000 kip). The wine glass is inferred from beer and bottle prices, the private hostel room from the dorm price, and the 1-star hotel from guesthouse listings. The midrange two-person figure excludes drinks and is adjusted down from a 2022 estimate that included wine. The FX value came from a search snippet of the RBA table, not a direct page read, and the 16 October figure may not yet have been published when this was generated.
comparable_city_reasoning: No external comparable city was used. Anchors are Vientiane-specific aggregated snapshots from MyLifeElsewhere, CityCost, Expatistan, Budget Your Trip, Hostelz, Kayak, Trip.com and Momondo. Wine glass is inferred from the beer anchor and bottle prices, and private hostel from the dorm anchor.
